assertion_rule: Every other scalar or empty container leaf is an occurrence; array indices are omitted from roles and retained in pointers.
relation_rule: A leaf named reference is a directed local resource edge; unresolved or ambiguous targets never match.
duplicates: Count occurrences, never deduplicate. Expected alternatives consume at most one occurrence. Excess identical occurrences are duplicates; excess different allowed alternatives are alternative_stuffing.
equivalence_rule: Only explicit per-assertion allowed_values; no implicit coding/display/unit/time/clinical equivalence.
cardinality_rule: Optional explicit resolved-edge min/max per subject+role, separate condition findings; no clinical cardinality inferred.
